settingsUrls.title: Service URLs
settingsUrls.desc: Configure the Base URL of each target service; the console forwards requests through /openan-playground/api/v1/debug-proxy. Default addresses point directly to the Aliyun IP (47.236.98.226:9004) and are forwarded by nginx short prefixes to the server's internal services: /rc/ → Registry (5000), /oc/ → Orchestration (5001), /a2a/ → this system's Mock Agent (9100), /ot/ → Ontology (8787).
settingsUrls.adminOnly: Only admins can modify service URLs

dataset.expandedHint: Each request-response pair shares the same work order, port, sequence number and timestamp, aligned with the expected output contract; MockAgent returns the closest matching pair per request.
dataset.subtitle: Request-response pair datasets: seed dataset (Demo live-captured) + expanded dataset (full template coverage, 5000+ pairs), associated with Mock Agents by template role
dataset.noScopeHint: Unscoped: retrieval covers all templates in the dataset

seed.name: A2A-T Demo Seed Dataset
seed.source: A2A-T Demo.docx (two ticket collaboration logs: Ticket 1 — cross-region service outage with negotiation; Ticket 2 — cross-region SLA degradation with expedited restoration)
seed.note: Paired request-response: request samples can be sent from "Prompt source" in the A2A-T SDK Console; responses are stub-variant round-robin replies (verbatim identical to the real Demo responses).

expanded.name: A2A-T Expanded Dataset
expanded.source: Programmatic expansion: a2a-t SDK zh-CN template rendering + A2A-T Demo captured template structure; responses share the same identifiers (ticket no. / port / seq no. / time) with requests, aligned to the expected-output contract
expanded.note: Paired request-response (cross-verified by shared identifiers): all value combinations per template × instance parameter groups; 16 templates covered in total.

seeds.title: Seed Management
seeds.importHint: Select the variants.json generated by local tools/stub_generator (format: {{format}})

list.label: List Agent Cards
list.note: Supports ?name=&organization= filters; returns all cards (including pending). includeStatus=true attaches publishStatus to each card (strict proto clients such as orchestration should not enable it)

get.label: Get Agent Card
get.note: Exact lookup by organization + name, regardless of publish status; includeStatus=true attaches publishStatus

register.label: Register Agent Card
register.note: With signature validation enabled in production, include signatures; the dev instance may disable validation

update.label: Update Agent Card
update.note: Path is {organization}/{name} and must match the card content; edit the path before sending

manage.label: Manage List (with publish status)
manage.note: Returns all cards with publishStatus (same behavior as the list query)

publish.label: Publish Approval (registered→published)
publish.note: Replace {organization}/{name} in the path; body must contain a non-empty remark, otherwise the card stays unlisted

execute.label: Execute Workflow (SSE stream)
execute.note: Auto-searches or generates a PSOP and executes it, returning a relayed SSE event stream

send.label: A2A Message Send (non-streaming)
send.note: Targets the host agent's A2A endpoint (defaults to this system's Mock Agent; change it in Settings → Service URLs); requires the A2A-Version header

runs.label: Run Ontology Reasoning (NDJSON stream)
runs.note: Returns a relayed NDJSON event stream (run.started/ontology.focus/agent.message/a2at.request/a2at.response/run.completed)
